Depth wallpaper with spatial clock occlusion

I wanted to know if one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas can composite a live editable clock behind a foreground HTML and SVG cutout with 3-plane parallax while keeping controls clickable via updateElementGeometry(). Drag across the wallpaper, edit the date pill or toggle depth occlusion.

Show the code ElementGL two-layer slots, premultiplied depth shader, 3-plane parallax and 2D/plain fallbacks
  1. Two drawable layers in one canvas. #dw-clock-layer holds the editable date pill, quick widgets and giant <output> clock, while #dw-subject-layer holds the inline SVG peak and HTML foreground badge inside one <canvas content="drawable" layoutsubtree>.
  2. Premultiplied uploads into ELEMENT_COUNT slots. Sets UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL = true on creation and restore, gates uploads on hasPainted inside paint, and calls stage.begin() before stage.upload(layerEl).
  3. Twilight sky shader and premultiplied occlusion composite. Draws the sky and distant hills at 0.35x, samples #dw-clock-layer at 0.70x and #dw-subject-layer at 1.35x, and blends premultiplied foreground alpha with fg.rgb + col * (1.0 - fg.a).
  4. Parallax motion and calibrated hit geometry. Updates updateElementGeometry() for #dw-clock-layer using geometryUnit() and flips dataset.hitTick so the date input and widgets stay clickable as the clock shifts.
  5. Five-argument 2D and plain-HTML fallbacks. Composites both layers with 5-argument drawElementImage() without WebGL 2, or moves them into #plain-host when context loss occurs.

How it works

  • One <canvas id="dw-canvas" content="drawable" layoutsubtree> owns one WebGL 2 context through ElementGL (/lib/element-gl.js). Inside it sit two drawable subtrees: #dw-clock-layer for the live clock, editable date input and quick pills, and #dw-subject-layer for the inline SVG granite ridge and engraved HTML elevation tag.
  • Inside the paint listener, hasPainted turns true, stage.begin() sizes and clears the backing buffer, and only dirty slots among the ELEMENT_COUNT (2) layers re-upload via stage.upload(layerEl) (gl.texElementSubImage2D()). Dragging or running Auto drift updates only shader uniforms and updateElementGeometry() with zero texture re-uploads.
  • Setting gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL, true) on context creation and inside onRestored gives premultiplied RGBA texels for both DOM layers. That stops translucent frosted pills (rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16)) from washing out to solid white and lets fg.rgb + clock.rgb * (1.0 - fg.a) blend the anti-aliased mountain edge over bright digits without dark fringes.
  • Each frame shifts the three visual planes at separate parallax multipliers: 0.35x for the twilight sky and distant shader ridges, 0.70x for #dw-clock-layer, and 1.35x for #dw-subject-layer. Switching between Depth occlusion on, Flat overlay (clock in front) and Mask alpha debug swaps compositing order in the fragment shader without changing the DOM.
  • #dw-subject-layer stays inert with pointer-events: none while syncHitGeometry() positions #dw-clock-layer through canvas.updateElementGeometry() scaled by geometryUnit() and toggles dataset.hitTick so the upper widgets and date <input> stay clickable.

Live checks

Each check builds an isolated fixture on testStage() so the live wallpaper above isn't disturbed.

ResultExperimentDetail

Findings

Measured in headless Google Chrome 160.0.8188.0 canary on 2026-11-27 at 412x915 and 2.625 DPR (SwiftShader WebGL). Headless Chromium 157, npm run check:jank and Chrome 159 on Android stay not verified.

  • Premultiplied uploads stop frosted pill washout and edge fringes. Setting gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL, true) on context creation and inside onRestored yielded true premultiplied texels (translucent rgba(255,255,255,0.20) pill measured rgb(67,78,101) over dark rgb(15,20,36) sky instead of solid white), and blending fg.rgb + col * (1.0 - fg.a) kept the anti-aliased ridge free of dark halos.
  • Separating hit-cache clears from texture uploads keeps Auto drift at 2 uploads. Initially, flipping dataset.hitTick inside syncHitGeometry() triggered fresh paint events with #dw-clock-layer in changedElements, driving uploads from 108 to 181 in 1.2 seconds. Gating stage.upload() on explicit slot.dirty flags inside paint (reading changedElements only while the text input holds focus) held uploads flat at 2 during continuous parallax motion.
  • Don't call stage.upload() synchronously outside paint. Calling drawCurrentFrame() straight after mutating a widget button label uploaded the stale paint record and cleared slot.dirty before the next frame's paint event arrived, leaving the canvas pill one state behind. Restricting uploads to the paint handler fixes the one-frame lag.
  • Three-plane parallax and clickable controls work together. Shifting sky at 0.35x, clock at 0.70x (measured 28.0 px shift across -20 to +20) and foreground cutout at 1.35x (54.0 px) moved the peak independently across the digits while geometryUnit()-scaled updateElementGeometry() kept #dw-date-tag and #dw-widget-depth clickable across a 28 px shift.
  • Fallbacks and reduced motion hold layout steady. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, automatic drift and sky shimmer paused and the .motion-warn notice hid and restored #dw-stage cleanly. With texElementSubImage2D deleted, the 5-argument drawElementImage() 2D route passed occlusion and hit-testing checks at 5.61 MB; with drawElementImage deleted, plain HTML kept both layers legible at scrollWidth === innerWidth === 412.
  • Not verified on real mobile hardware: touch-dragging across the lock screen while tapping quick widgets at 412 px and 2.625 DPR on Chrome 159 for Android, real GPU frame rates, and deviceorientation sensor tilt.
